scope: Tailor Mother garment member removal and re-entry only
trigger: A garment is removed from the physics member set and later reinserted while retained garments have advanced.

realFailure.summary: After pants and inner advanced 28 steps, adding outer reset the whole world to step 0; the restored initial mesh had zero discrete crossings, then step 4 failed at 1.044 mm contact residual after three accepted steps.

mustNeverRepeat: call a global redress and clock/history reset a resume
treat zero discrete middle-surface crossings as thickness-clearance proof
mutate the active accepted world while testing a new member without an atomic rollback point
approve re-entry from the initial frame or fewer steps than the known delayed-failure window
remove collision participants merely because their rendering is hidden
requiredEvidence: exact active member-set digest and accepted state digest before staging
retained p/v/old, constraints/rest, material/thickness, contact-history policy, clock and body-pose identity
staging-world identity distinct from the active world
at least 24 accepted steps after re-entry and three remove/reinsert cycles for this candidate
failed-insertion proof that the prior active-world digest is unchanged
atomic commit receipt for the new member set
gateLogic: HIDDEN_RENDER_ONLY keeps all solver and contact participation live
PHYSICS_DORMANT requires exact state retention plus a scoped clearance/contact-history policy
REMOVED_AND_REINSERTED must stage outside the active world and commit atomically only after its gate passes
a failed staging attempt leaves the prior active world and its accepted lineage unchanged
existing 0.5 mm contact and 1.45 stretch thresholds remain unchanged

dedupe.AUTHORING_NATIVE_HISTORY_SEPARATION_001: related but insufficient: it separates authoring reset from native continuity; it does not govern member-set mutation or atomic active-world commit
dedupe.SOLVER_FAILURE_NOT_INFEASIBILITY_001: orthogonal: it limits claims from solver failure; it does not define re-entry custody
dedupe.PARTIAL_TRANSFER_NOT_PARENT_001: analogous staging principle but applies to byte transfer, not live physical state
